svg.text: The machine is grey cast plastic; the people are wood. Threat escalates by silhouette: flat → wheel → tower. Drawn to scale, 10 px = 1 mm.
THE MACHINE · threat pieces, one grey plastic
cog on its edge, a snapped tooth · 16 mm
cracked vacuum tube in its socket · 22 mm
Each reads with no colour at all; the wooden
Crew (round head) never reads as threat.
THE PEOPLE · wood, brass and slag
stained wooden rocket nose cones · 11 mm
slag lump, never two the same · 13 mm
ON THE BOARD · the same pieces on every section colour (pieces at 55 %)
Print-and-play: Glitch, Crew, influence and Decay die-cut to their top outline; Fault and Failure as small standees of their side view.
